newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Harmony completes Unisel takeover.
newsitem.headline: Harmony completes Unisel takeover.

text.p: Harmony Gold Mining Co Ltd said on Monday it had become the owner of the entire issued share capital of Unisel Gold Mines Ltd.
This completed a process started earlier this year when it acquired Gengold's interest in the mine, Harmony said in a statement.
It said Unisel shares were delisted on the Johannesburg and London stock exchanges at the close of business last Friday following Supreme Court approval of the scheme of arrangement.
Unisel was now a wholly owned subsidiary of Harmony.
Harmony managing director Bernard Swanepoel said the benefits anticipated from the acquisition could be fully realised now that Unisel was "formally as well as operationally integrated with Harmony".
